caption: Studies are ordered with the 6 cohorts whose enrolled population was confined to psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis first, followed by the 6 mixed-diagnosis cohorts. Diagnosis confined to psoriasis or PsA and psoriasis or PsA outcomes separable are two different questions and are reported as two separate columns; they diverge for exactly 2 studies, Day 2023 (confined, outcomes not separable) and Borgas 2020 (not confined, outcomes partially separable). Counts are numbers of patients unless procedures or surgeries are specified, and where a study reports the same diagnosis against two denominators both are stated. Drug class records the b/tsDMARD classes each study used and whether a single class could be isolated at the cohort level; TNF inhibitors were present in all 12 studies and were the only class with cohort-level isolable data, whereas IL-12/23 and JAK inhibitors appeared only inside mixed or aggregate exposures and could not be analyzed separately, and no study contributed IL-17, IL-23, or TYK2 inhibitor data. Procedure category follows the surgical-risk grouping: Arthroplasty denotes prosthesis-bearing hip or knee replacement, the only setting informing PJI; Other major denotes spine, open reduction and internal fixation, osteotomy, or open tendon or Achilles repair; and Lower-risk denotes hand or foot surgery, arthroscopy, or minor procedures. Mixed rows list the specific procedure counts. Exposure directness follows the primary comparison: Direct denotes actual continuation versus planned interruption of the same therapy, Timing-proxy denotes a shorter versus longer interval from last dose to surgery, and Contextual denotes biologic users versus nonusers or a chronic-use classification; timing-proxy and contextual studies were treated as indirect. MA1, primary comparative pool for infection or wound complications; MA2, comparative disease-flare pool. The main-text consolidation of this matrix is Table 1.
